generate_normally_distributed_tensor: generate a tensor of normally distributed random values using the Box-Muller transform via crypten randn
sample_bernoulli_from_tensor: sample Bernoulli random variables from an encrypted tensor where each element is 1 with probability equal to its value
compute_weighted_one_hot_index: compute a weighted one-hot index tensor along a dimension using crypten weighted_index on an encrypted tensor
sample_weighted_value_from_tensor: sample a single weighted value and its one-hot index from an encrypted tensor using crypten weighted_sample
review_sampling_functions: review the crypten sampling module functions randn, bernoulli, weighted_index, and weighted_sample for MPC-compatible random sampling
